title: Rescue Team
description:
Airmen stationed in Guam make the trip to Korea to teach new rescue techniques to fire fighters at Camp Casey, Korea.
Suggested lead: 
Ever been in a sticky situation?  Army sergeant Thanh Pham shows us who will answer the call when you need help.
Suggested tag:
The team was here for six weeks and also taught a class at Camp Carroll. Also available in high definition.
